445161.overview:
Welcome to Bricklandia, home of a massive open-world LEGO driving adventure. Race anywhere, play with anyone, build your dream rides, and defeat a cast of wild racing rivals for the coveted Sky Trophy!

In LEGO 2K Drive, your awesome transforming vehicle gives you the freedom to speed seamlessly across riveting racetracks, off-road terrain, and open waters. Explore the vast world of Bricklandia, show off your driving skills, and build vehicles brick-by-brick!

479209.overview: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight is an action-adventure developed by Traveller's Tales and published by Warner Bros. Games. It is the fourth installment in the Lego Batman video game series, and features an original story inspired by comic books, films and other media from the Batman franchise. Legacy of the Dark Knight uses Unreal Engine 5 as opposed to TT Games' proprietary game engine, and takes heavy inspiration from Batman: Arkham, another series of Batman video games.
